
# OneTechWork

> OneTechWork is a digital technology and software development company serving clients in India and internationally.

## About

OneTechWork provides digital solutions to businesses, startups, and individuals. The company focuses on building modern, scalable, and user-friendly technology products.

Official website: https://onetechwork.com

## Services

- Website Development
- Mobile App Development
- Custom Software Development
- UI/UX Design
- Cloud and Backend Solutions
- AI Solutions

## Target Markets

- India
- International clients
